items.Sentence: Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains, a SAFE system box, and two parallel fine screens.
Raw wastewater will be conveyed to the Facility headworks, which will include two coarse screen and grit removal trains.
Screened effluent and return activated sludge will flow into two biological nutrient removal (BNR) basins... each consisting of pre-anoxic, aerobic, and post-anoxic basins in-series.
Screened effluent and return activated sludge will flow into two biological nutrient removal (BNR) basins and then pumped to the MBR.
The SAFE settling basin, will capture and equalize the wet weather flows... it passes over a weir and flows to the SAFE filter system for filtration treatment... will provide sedimentation treatment.
During higher volume peak flow events, effluent will fill the SAFE settling basin... until it passes over a weir and flows to the SAFE filter system for filtration treatment.
IPR system treatment consists of cartridge filters, an RO system, ultraviolet disinfection with advanced oxidation (UV/AOP) chlorination, and a calcite contactor.
IPR system treatment consists of cartridge filters, an RO system, ultraviolet disinfection with advanced oxidation (UV/AOP) chlorination, and a calcite contactor.

Tertiary treated effluent from the outfall balancing tank will be pumped through an outfall disinfection chlorine contact pipeline.

RO concentrate will also be diverted directly to the RO concentrate disinfection contact pipeline for chlorination prior to commingling with the outfall disinfection contact pipeline upstream of the dechlorination injection point.
...will then be dechlorinated by sodium bisulfite injection prior to discharge through the ocean outfall.
The sludge holding tanks will receive, store, and aerate activated sludge wasted from the BNR MBR process... each zone including mixers and bubble diffusers.
The sludge dewatering system will pump waste sludge from the sludge holding tanks... and dewatered by a belt filter press with a polymer storage and feed system.
Dewatered biosolids will be transported offsite for beneficial use or landfill.
